purpose: Teach: 閉会/ゲン/ヘルス/賜り/設問/緊密/同点/勧める

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業者として、創業祭の閉会、私、何度も、立ち会ってきた、本当に、心、震えるよ、お父さん、お前にも、感動的な、瞬間、経験して欲しい、本気で、絶対、本当に、頼んだ。
lines.en: As the founder, I've stood witness to the closing ceremony of our founding festival many times. It truly shakes my heart. I want you to experience a moment that moves you like this, son. I'm serious. I'm asking you—really asking you.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate opening. Weight in the voice like recalling something precious. Soft tremor on 「心、震える」. Shifts to direct address—firmer, more earnest. The closing plea is quieter, intimate, a grandfather's genuine request, not a demand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、ゲン担ぎ、創業者の習慣、本当に、続いておりますよ、私の代でも、絶対、続けていきます、伝統として、本当に、引き継ぎますからね、絶対、お父さん。
lines.en: Yes. Since your era, we've continued the ritual, the founder's tradition. In my time, I will absolutely keep it going as our legacy. You can count on that, Father.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. Clear commitment in the voice—not overeager, measured and sincere. Slight emphasis on 「続けていきます」 to show resolve. Closes with warm reassurance, eyes meeting his.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 当社の、ヘルスケア事業、お父さん、本気で、考えていたんだ、覚えてる、お前?新時代の、本気、見せていけ、絶対、本当に、頼んだぞ、社員、皆、絶対、絶対、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: The healthcare business—your father thought seriously about this vision from the start. Do you remember? I want to show that same serious commitment for this new era. I'm asking you, and everyone on the team—really asking.
lines.style: Shifts to purposeful and direct. Opens with reminiscence—softer, almost tender. Then builds intensity toward the request. The repeated 「絶対」 lands with quiet conviction, not aggression. A mentoring tone: passing the torch.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんから、本当に、たくさんの教え、賜り、私、絶対、忘れません、創業精神、引き継いでまいります、本当に、感謝しております、お父さん、ありがとう、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I've received so much wisdom from you, Father. I will never forget it. I carry forward the founding spirit. I'm truly grateful—thank you. I'm serious about this, truly serious.
lines.style: Humble and warm. The gratitude sits genuinely in the voice, not performed. Slight catch or softening on 「感謝しております」. Closes with quiet sincerity—a son's promise to his father, earnest and grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 新人試験の設問、お父さんの代から、私、考えてきたぞ、お前にも、若手育成の、本気、見せていけ、絶対、本当に、頼んだぞ、絶対、これは、絶対、お父さんからの、お願いだ。
lines.en: The questions we ask our new hires—I've thought about them since your time. I want you to show that same seriousness in developing our young people. I'm asking you. This is truly what I'm asking of you.
lines.style: Opens reflective—looking back at inherited responsibility. Then firms up with clear direction. The final repetition of the request is quiet but unambiguous. A father passing down not just a task, but a philosophy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お得意様と、創業以来、本当に、緊密な、関係、築いて、まいりました、私の代でも、絶対、続けてまいります、お父さん、ご安心ください、絶対、本当に、頼みます、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We've built close relationships with our valued clients since the very beginning. In my time, I will absolutely continue that. Please rest assured, Father. I'm serious about this—truly.
lines.style: Warm and steady. Quiet confidence in building and maintaining those bonds. No rushing—each phrase lands with care. The reassurance is genuine, grounded. Closes with the same solemn pledge as before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、業界、同点の競争、何度も、経験したな、覚えてる、お父さん、当時の、必死さ、お前にも、伝えたい、本気で、絶対、頼んだぞ、これは、絶対に、お父さんから、本当に。
lines.en: In the early days, we faced fierce competition neck-and-neck with everyone else in the industry. Many times. Do you remember? That desperation of those days—I want to pass that on to you. I'm serious. This is what I need you to carry forward.
lines.style: Opens nostalgic and almost wistful—a memory returning. Slight ache in the voice. Then shifts to determined—the closing request is firmer, a grandfather's plea that this harder-won wisdom not be lost. Weight on 「絶対に」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、創業時に、勧める姿勢、本当に、私の心に、刻まれております、絶対、お父さんの代の精神、引き継ぎます、本当に、本気で、絶対、お父さん、信じてください、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The way you showed us forward during those founding days—it's carved into my heart. I will absolutely carry forward that spirit from your era. Truly, seriously. Father, believe in me. Absolutely.
lines.style: Quiet reverence under the surface. The word 「刻まれております」 carries real emotion—what you've given me is deep and lasting. Closes with steady conviction, a son looking his father in the eye with quiet confidence and love.
